_comment: npc_line pool (Docs/WEIRDNESS_SPEC.md §9, ledger M-8). Nineteen lines, LOCKED. Deadpan; sayable as mundane; nothing supernatural in the wording; pronoun-free toward Patch, so [U2-7] gender variants are not required here. The tagline "It's mostly fine." is deliberately excluded. The NPC says one of these in an idle bubble — never the dialogue box — and returns to normal idle. Never logged, never repeated in a run.

lines.text: Wind's from the wrong way again.
Did you hear that? No. Neither did I.
Second time today I've said that.
That's not where the well is.
We don't talk about the mill.
Sorry — thought you were someone else. You're not, are you.
